scene.polishPrompt: Review and polish the prose in this scene — improve rhythm and emotional resonance while respecting the original intent and authorship (human/AI). Call out what you change and why before showing each revision.
scene.expandPrompt: Expand the sensory and interior description in this scene. Stay close to the POV character's perception. Avoid bloat — only add what earns its place.
scene.dialoguePrompt: Audit the dialogue in this scene. Flag voice inconsistencies, over-explanation, and non-functional exchanges. Suggest concrete fixes.

folder.foreshadowPrompt: Identify the foreshadowing planted and paid off within this chapter. Call out contradictions, unpaid setups, and over-telegraphing.
folder.pacingPrompt: Analyze pacing across the scenes in this chapter — tension/release balance, info density, scene length. Point out drag, repetition, or rushed beats with specifics.
folder.outlinePrompt: Compare the existing chapter outline with what the scenes actually deliver, and propose an improved outline. Make each scene's goal, conflict, and turn explicit.
folder.arcPrompt: Review the overall structure of this act — does it land its three-act function (setup / confrontation / resolution)? Are theme and protagonist change visible? Be candid about what's missing.
folder.turningPrompt: Surface the major turning points in this act. For each, examine motivation, necessity, and character impact. Add reinforcement suggestions for weak ones.

project.plotPrompt: Step back across the whole project and audit the plot: planted vs. paid-off foreshadowing, causal coherence, setting/canon contradictions. Order findings by severity.
project.characterPrompt: Extract the arc of each major character and judge whether it lands — including unresolved desires. Be concrete about what's missing.
project.nextPrompt: Given the current trajectory, propose 3 outline options for the next chapter (or scene). For each: premise, central conflict, ending, and trade-offs.
project.foreshadowPrompt: Inventory all foreshadowing across the project with payoff status (paid / pending / partial) and where each is planned to land. Prioritize critical unpaid setups.

timeline.noPhasesDesc: Phases record state changes you want the AI to remember after scenes scroll out of context. Temporary events are lighter in scene body or synopsis. Phases can also serve as wiki-only notes the AI never sees.
timeline.orderModeReadingDesc: Phases apply in manuscript (writing) order. Information revealed in later scenes won't leak to AI when working on earlier scenes — good for mysteries and unreliable narrators.
timeline.orderModeStoryDesc: Phases apply by in-story chronological time. Flashbacks and non-linear narratives correctly reflect what's true at that moment.
timeline.orderModeAutoDesc: Scenes with a story-time set use chronological order; others fall back to reading order. A sensible default for most works.
timeline.exposureDesc: Only "AI-visible" phases are injected into the prompt. "Wiki-only" phases (suppress/hidden) never reach AI, so you can stack as many as you like for planning or pure record-keeping without bloating prompts.
timeline.exposureCostWarning: AI-visible summary is {{chars}} chars — a bit heavy. Trimming summaries or switching past phases to Wiki-only will lighten AI output.

act1.name: Act 1: Setup
act1.synopsis: Establish the protagonist's ordinary world and values. Plant the assumptions that will be challenged and the hooks that draw readers in.

act2.name: Act 2: Confrontation
act2.synopsis: Escalate obstacles as the protagonist pursues the goal. Layer internal, interpersonal, and external conflicts toward a midpoint shift in values.

act3.name: Act 3: Resolution
act3.synopsis: The protagonist faces the largest trial and the goal is decided. Show the changed world in the closing beats.

ki.name: Setup
ki.synopsis: Introduce situation, characters, and setting. Establish the world the story rests on.

sho.name: Development
sho.synopsis: Expand the situation set up in Ki. Build events and relationships, planting the seeds for the twist.

ten.name: Twist
ten.synopsis: A pivotal turn that overturns prior assumptions. Surprise the reader with an event or shift in perspective.

ketsu.name: Conclusion
ketsu.synopsis: Absorb the change introduced by the twist and bring the story to a close. Shape the lingering aftertaste.

exposition.name: Exposition
exposition.synopsis: Introduce characters, place, and situation. Show the stable state before the story begins.

risingAction.name: Rising Action
risingAction.synopsis: The protagonist pursues the goal as conflicts pile up. Tension rises in stages.

climax.name: Climax
climax.synopsis: The story's most dramatic moment. A decisive turning point for the protagonist's fate.

fallingAction.name: Falling Action
fallingAction.synopsis: The aftermath spreads outward. Remaining conflicts move toward resolution.

resolution.name: Resolution
resolution.synopsis: The final settlement. Show the new stable state and the changed characters.

act1.name: Act 1
act1.synopsis: The setup half. Establish the ordinary world and what the protagonist lacks, deliver the catalyst, and force the no-going-back decision through debate. Plant the theme and the stakes so readers feel the bet.

act2.name: Act 2
act2.synopsis: The heart of the story. The protagonist adapts to the new world, the B-story embodies the theme, false victories and defeats compound, and the dark night of the soul leads to the real answer. The transformation gets tested here.

act3.name: Act 3
act3.synopsis: The synthesis. Armed with the new solution, the protagonist faces the climax and rebuilds the world as a changed self. The final image mirrors the opening, making the change visible.

openingImage.name: Opening Image
openingImage.synopsis: A single visual scene that conveys the world and tone at a glance. The 'before' that pairs with the Final Image.

themeStated.name: Theme Stated
themeStated.synopsis: Another character casually voices the truth the protagonist must eventually learn. The protagonist doesn't yet grasp it.

setup.name: Setup
setup.synopsis: Present the protagonist's daily life, flaws, goal, and relationships. Make the problem that needs fixing clear to the reader.

catalyst.name: Catalyst
catalyst.synopsis: An event that breaks the daily routine. The irreversible push that sends the protagonist toward the adventure.

debate.name: Debate
debate.synopsis: The protagonist wavers between going forward or staying. The hesitation before committing to the journey.

breakIntoTwo.name: Break into Two
breakIntoTwo.synopsis: The protagonist decides and steps into the new world. A choice that cannot be reversed.

bStory.name: B Story
bStory.synopsis: A subplot (often romance or friendship) that embodies the theme begins. The axis that supports the protagonist's inner change.

funAndGames.name: Fun and Games
funAndGames.synopsis: The genre's signature scenes. Deliver on the promise that brought readers to this story.

midpoint.name: Midpoint
midpoint.synopsis: A false victory or false defeat. The protagonist seems to reach the goal, but the cost is starting to surface.

badGuysClose.name: Bad Guys Close In
badGuysClose.synopsis: Antagonistic forces draw closer; pressure mounts inside and out. The team may begin to fracture.

allIsLost.name: All Is Lost
allIsLost.synopsis: The lowest point. The protagonist loses something precious — companions, hope, or self-image. A whiff of death.

darkNightOfSoul.name: Dark Night of the Soul
darkNightOfSoul.synopsis: From the bottom of despair the protagonist confronts the truth. Inner reckoning that arrives at the lesson stated earlier.

breakIntoThree.name: Break into Three
breakIntoThree.synopsis: Armed with a new solution the protagonist rises again. A Story and B Story converge.

finale.name: Finale
finale.synopsis: The climax. The transformed protagonist takes on the final battle and remakes the world.

finalImage.name: Final Image
finalImage.synopsis: An image that pairs with the Opening Image. Show at a glance how the world and characters have changed.

departure.name: Departure
departure.synopsis: The Departure stage. Ordinary world → call → refusal → mentor → crossing the threshold. The psychological and physical transition that lands the protagonist in the unknown world.

initiation.name: Initiation
initiation.synopsis: The Initiation stage. Tests/allies/enemies, approach to the inmost cave, the supreme ordeal (a symbolic death), and the reward. The protagonist’s abilities, values, and self-image are tested — the core where transformation is forged.

returnAct.name: Return
returnAct.synopsis: The Return stage. Choosing to return, resurrection (final transformation), and bringing the elixir back to the community. Where what was earned in the trial becomes value in the ordinary world.

ordinaryWorld.name: Ordinary World
ordinaryWorld.synopsis: The protagonist's old life and unmet desire. The baseline before the adventure begins.

callToAdventure.name: Call to Adventure
callToAdventure.synopsis: A message or event that disturbs the ordinary world and summons the protagonist to action.

refusal.name: Refusal of the Call
refusal.synopsis: Out of fear or duty the protagonist resists the call. The hesitation of an ordinary person.

meeting.name: Meeting the Mentor
meeting.synopsis: A guide appears and grants the protagonist necessary tools, knowledge, or courage.

crossingThreshold.name: Crossing the Threshold
crossingThreshold.synopsis: The protagonist leaves the ordinary world and steps into the unknown. A point of no return.

testsAlliesEnemies.name: Tests, Allies, Enemies
testsAlliesEnemies.synopsis: Learn the rules of the new world. Identify allies and enemies and test the protagonist's abilities.

approach.name: Approach to the Inmost Cave
approach.synopsis: Preparation and tension before the greatest trial. The team debates strategy and steels itself.

ordeal.name: The Ordeal
ordeal.synopsis: The protagonist symbolically experiences death. The greatest fear must be confronted.

reward.name: Reward
reward.synopsis: The prize won by surviving the ordeal — physical treasure, knowledge, reconciliation, or self-knowledge.

roadBack.name: The Road Back
roadBack.synopsis: The decision to return home. Pursued by remaining enemies, new obstacles arise.

resurrection.name: Resurrection
resurrection.synopsis: The climax. In the final trial the protagonist is fully transformed and reborn as a new self.

returnWithElixir.name: Return with the Elixir
returnWithElixir.synopsis: The changed protagonist returns to the ordinary world and shares what was gained with the community.

youInZone.name: You
youInZone.synopsis: The protagonist sits in a comfort zone. Stable, but something is missing.

needWantDiscomfort.name: Need
needWantDiscomfort.synopsis: The protagonist becomes aware of what is missing. A felt absence drives the journey.

unfamiliarSituation.name: Go
unfamiliarSituation.synopsis: The protagonist steps into an unfamiliar situation. A choice to leave the comfort zone.

adaptationFunGames.name: Search
adaptationFunGames.synopsis: Adapt to the rules of the new world. Trial, error, and discovery.

beginToWantMoreSelf.name: Find
beginToWantMoreSelf.synopsis: The protagonist obtains what was wanted. But the price is only beginning to surface.

familiar.name: Take
familiar.synopsis: Learn the cost paid for what was gained. The weight of the choice arrives.

bigChangeTryFail.name: Return
bigChangeTryFail.synopsis: Carry the change back to the comfort zone. The old world no longer looks the same.

returnChanged.name: Change
returnChanged.synopsis: Reintegrate as a changed self. The contrast with who the protagonist was becomes clear.

ch1.name: Ch. 1: Hook
ch1.synopsis: The opening scene that draws the reader in. Convey the world, tone, and the core of the protagonist at once.

ch2.name: Ch. 2: Setup
ch2.synopsis: Present the protagonist's daily life and what is lacking. Lay the assumptions that will be broken.

ch3.name: Ch. 3: Inciting Incident
ch3.synopsis: The first event that disrupts the routine. Cracks open in the protagonist's world.

ch4.name: Ch. 4: Refusal & Decision
ch4.synopsis: Wrestling with how to respond to the incident. The fork between accepting and refusing the journey.

ch5.name: Ch. 5: Into the New World
ch5.synopsis: The protagonist commits and crosses into the new world. A step that cannot be undone.

ch6.name: Ch. 6: Exploration & Discovery
ch6.synopsis: Learn the rules, enemies, and allies of the new world. The stakes become concrete.

ch7.name: Ch. 7: First Pinch
ch7.synopsis: The opposition makes its first serious move and damages the protagonist.

ch8.name: Ch. 8: Regrouping
ch8.synopsis: Recover from defeat. Reorganize the team and rework the strategy.

ch9.name: Ch. 9: Midgame
ch9.synopsis: A central peak of the story. The protagonist's understanding and capability expand greatly.

ch10.name: Ch. 10: False Victory
ch10.synopsis: Looks like success on the surface. Underneath, costs are accumulating.

ch11.name: Ch. 11: Reversal
ch11.synopsis: The moment perspective or situation flips. Earlier assumptions are overturned.

ch12.name: Ch. 12: Second Pinch
ch12.synopsis: Antagonists tighten the screws. Trust within the team begins to crack.

ch13.name: Ch. 13: Crisis Deepens
ch13.synopsis: Things get worse. The protagonist's options disappear one by one.

ch14.name: Ch. 14: All Is Lost
ch14.synopsis: The greatest loss. The lowest point where something precious is taken away.

ch15.name: Ch. 15: Dark Night
ch15.synopsis: From the bottom of despair the protagonist reflects and arrives at the answer truly needed.

ch16.name: Ch. 16: Rally
ch16.synopsis: A new resolve. Stand up again with whatever remains.

ch17.name: Ch. 17: Into Act 3
ch17.synopsis: The third act opens. Preparations for the climax begin.

ch18.name: Ch. 18: Reunion
ch18.synopsis: Companions reassemble and align for the final battle.

ch19.name: Ch. 19: Final Approach
ch19.synopsis: The last obstacle surfaces and forces a decisive choice from the protagonist.

ch20.name: Ch. 20: Last Obstacle
ch20.synopsis: Quiet just before the climax. The stakes peak.

ch21.name: Ch. 21: Climax
ch21.synopsis: The climax. The protagonist faces the final trial as a true self.

ch22.name: Ch. 22: Final Battle
ch22.synopsis: The last phase of the final battle. The fate of the world is decided.

ch23.name: Ch. 23: Resolution
ch23.synopsis: After the dust settles. Remaining issues are resolved one by one.

ch24.name: Ch. 24: Epilogue
ch24.synopsis: Show the changed protagonist's new daily life and close the story.

onboarding.title: Welcome to Grimodex
onboarding.subtitle: An integrated writing environment for crafting novels with AI. Here are the six key features.

scenes.title: Scene Structure
scenes.desc: Manage chapters, scenes, and notes in a tree view. Freely reorder them with drag & drop.

chat.title: AI Chat
chat.desc: Each scene has its own AI conversation history. Use it for story consultation and writing assistance.

codex.title: Codex
codex.desc: A knowledge base for characters, locations, and lore. Extract entries directly from AI conversations.

snippets.title: Snippets
snippets.desc: Save important phrases and passages from AI conversations to reuse in your writing later.

editor.title: Rich Text Editor
editor.desc: Write comfortably with a TipTap-based editor. Supports Markdown syntax and formatting, with each scene edited independently.

layout.title: Layout
layout.desc: Freely customize panel visibility and size. Arrange your workspace to match your writing style.

preflight.step2Subtitle: You can change your provider at any time later.
preflight.step3Subtitle: Don't have an API key? Choose 'Set up later' to continue.
preflight.setupLaterConfirm: No provider configured — AI features will start as Off. You can set it up later in Settings > AI.

full.label: Use all AI features
full.desc: Full use of chat, writing assist, and consistency checks

reviewOnly.label: Analysis only
reviewOnly.desc: Consistency checks only. No chat or auto-generation

off.label: No AI
off.desc: Fully local writing mode. All AI features are off

tour.skipConfirmDesc: You can restart it any time from Settings > About.
tour.actionRequired: Complete the action above, then press Next

overview.title: Scenes panel
overview.body: The manuscript is represented as a tree. Export concatenates content in this exact order.

addItems.title: What you can add
addItems.body: Three item types are available: Scenes (prose), Folders (grouping), and Notes (memos).

hierarchy.title: Reorder and nest
hierarchy.body: Drag any item by its left-edge handle to move it. Folders can be nested too.

action.title: Open a scene
action.body: Click 'Awakening of the Swordsman' to open it. A tab will appear in the editor and you can start editing.

overview.title: Customizing the layout
overview.body: Drag panel borders to resize. The 'Layout' dropdown in the top-right switches between presets, and the 'Panels' dropdown shows or hides individual panels.

overview.title: Editor
overview.body: Each scene opens its own tab. Prose supports Markdown syntax, ruby annotations, and emphasis dots. Edits are saved automatically.

beatNode.title: Beat nodes
beatNode.body: The grey bordered block is a Beat node. Write what happens in the scene there — it stays out of the final prose. The AI reads the Beat to generate the corresponding body text. Add a Beat with the / command.

overview.title: Snippets
overview.body: Save reusable passages or memos. Drag and drop into the editor, or insert via the button.

action.title: Insert a snippet
action.body: Insert a snippet into the editor.

overview.title: Codex
overview.body: A knowledge base for characters, locations, and lore — and the source of context fed to the AI.

action.title: Open an entry
action.body: Select an entry from the left list to view its details.

fourLayers.title: Summary vs. content
fourLayers.body: Summary and Content are both sent to the AI. Use Summary for light character info and Content for deeper background.

overview.title: AI Chat
overview.body: Build the story and worldbuilding through dialogue with the AI. Each scene keeps its own chat history (session).

contextBar.title: Context bar
contextBar.body: Codex entries linked to the current scene are automatically injected as context. You can also add entries manually via Spotlight.

contextUsage.title: Context window usage
contextUsage.body: The graph below the input shows how much of the context window is consumed. Narrowing context when usage is high improves response quality.

promptPreview.title: Prompt preview
promptPreview.body: Click the tokens badge to open a dialog showing the full system prompt and a per-layer token breakdown — exactly what the AI receives. Give it a try.

injectedContext.title: Injected context depth
injectedContext.body: Spotlighted entries inject full descriptions; auto-added entries inject summaries only. Use Spotlight selectively to control context weight.

overview.title: Chat → Codex extraction
overview.body: Select any text in an AI reply — an 'Add to Codex' button appears in the popup. Press it to save that text as a new Codex entry instantly. World-building born in chat stays in chat no more.

action.title: Try it yourself
action.body: Select text in one of the AI messages and press 'Add to Codex'.

overview.title: Beat-driven AI writing
overview.body: The AI reads the Beat's content and generates the prose that follows. Hit the generate button (▷ icon) at the right edge of a Beat node to run it.

overview.title: Foreshadowing register
overview.body: Structurally manage each foreshadow's intent and state. Link setup scenes to their payoff scenes and track them all in one place.

action.title: Explore the sample foreshadows
action.body: Click an entry in the list to see how its setup scene and payoff scene are linked together.

overview.title: Consistency check
overview.body: An AI scan that finds contradictions between your prose and Codex / prior scenes — like a character's eye color suddenly changing. Results appear in this panel.

action.title: Run the check
action.body: Press the review button in the editor toolbar to start a consistency analysis. Flagged passages are highlighted inline and listed here.

overview.title: Timeline
overview.body: View scenes in narrative order or in chronological order. See the flow of the story at a glance.

zoom.title: Zoom and reorder
zoom.body: Scroll-wheel to zoom the time axis. Drag to reposition scenes when the order needs adjusting.

summary.title: Tutorial complete!
summary.body: You've walked through the Grimodex core workflow. Feel free to keep practicing on this sample project.

restartHint.title: What's next
restartHint.body: Open a new workspace and start writing. You can rerun this tutorial any time from Settings > About.
